'''Team Commander''' was a title used by [[Vulca Minerals]]. They oversaw [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. On [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]], the Team Commander was almost killed by members of the [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]] when they got pushy about the state of the [[yttrium]] mining.
